commands.native: zig build --build-file zig/build.zig -Doptimize=Debug antfly logical-field-query-test query-contract-test antfly-schema-contract-test lib-decisions-test runtime-error-identities-test -j2
commands.profile: ANTFLY_BIN=<before-or-after-server>/antfly ANTFLY_LOGICAL_STREAM_REPORT=<report.json> uv run --project zig/e2e/antfly pytest -q zig/e2e/antfly/test_grep_indexed.py -k logical_mixed_work_profile

qualification_scope: 4096 documents / 16900096 canonical source bytes, seven trials per workload per binary. Exact counts and corpus/binary hashes are verified.
Debug servers on a shared macOS host, warm caches; wall times include HTTP, host contention and a substantial main merge. These are end-to-end comparisons, not isolated optimization microbenchmarks.

Work counters exclude response hydration. Mixed OR siblings share bounded membership; AND and indexed sibling selectivity are preserved. The regular regression fits one pass under its 20 MiB / 4096-load policy.
Cache tests cover oversized and pinned-budget admission, shared readers surviving eviction/expiry, deferred sibling errors, and a narrow immutable intersection using only a 256-byte allocator.
The 16 MiB cache cap includes retired pinned entries and in-flight construction; no source bodies or snapshot capabilities are stored in it.
No production RSS, cold-storage, native Linux hardware, Windows runtime, live-provider relevance/cost, or full ripgrep/PCRE2 parity claim. Fixtures only for providers.
